findings.title: The new head finds the six no-shadow findings the head we published missed
findings.what: On the shippability bar's real-code corpus (602 TypeScript files at 53f5b92a1), the typescript pack at f06640857 reports every finding 0.1.5 reports, including the six typescript-eslint-no-shadow findings aad1dd6ef missed (code-rule-bridge.test.ts lines 119, 160, 245, 447; native-code-rule-dsl-runtime.test.ts:3477; pack-test-data.test.mjs:468). No rule run stops at its work budget (5 did at aad1dd6ef). The fix's commit (8df0e8092) names the cause: five files ran out of work.
findings.severity: positive: a finding we reported is fixed

findings.title: The new head adds 301 findings in one file 0.1.5 cannot parse, and loses none
findings.what: Over the six packs' real-code corpora, no finding of 0.1.5 is missing at the new head. It adds 282 javascript, 18 typescript and 1 node findings, all in src/cli/rule-draft.ts, which names a variable `using`: #735 (in main, merged into the branch) lets the new head parse it, where 0.1.5 records 'file has syntax errors' (599 rule runs over the six packs). A person upgrading sees these findings on such files.

findings.title: Still 370 of 382 rules on with today's four common packs
findings.what: Set-up with typescript 0.1.7, python 0.1.9, complexity 0.1.7 and javascript 0.1.8 says 382 rules; a session's start at f06640857 says 370 rules are on. The same 12 token-test rules are skipped, with the same log line, as at aad1dd6ef.
findings.severity: medium: unchanged from what we published

findings.title: The content store is now content-v5.sqlite
findings.what: An upgrade from 0.1.5 (content-v1.sqlite) or from aad1dd6ef (content-v4.sqlite) starts every repository from an empty store at f06640857; 0.1.5's file stays on disk. The daemon started on a home 0.1.5 set up and answered.
findings.severity: informative: our published text says content-v4.sqlite

findings.title: Five of our nine fixes now meet merge conflicts, all new ones from main's #708 and #680
findings.what: fix 2, fix 4, fix 6 and #677 merge into f06640857 as they are (#677 met 0.1.5's merge conflicts at aad1dd6ef; 0.1.5 is now an ancestor). fix 1, fix 3, fix 5 (#674), #665 and #676 meet merge conflicts in repository-identity.ts, repository-registry.ts and its test (#708) and in code-rule-bridge.ts and runtime.ts (#680). Each also meets them merging into main at 39b59e9d7 alone. The merge conflicts from the new engine (ci.yml, native/src/lib.rs, native.ts, one import line) are those we reported.
findings.severity: medium: for whoever lands the fixes

findings.title: The Linux engine grew 5.6%
findings.what: npm run build:native at f06640857: 142.7 MB (135.1 MB at aad1dd6ef, 53.0 MB at 0.1.5, 2.69 times). The new head adds rerail-clif, the Go and C lean parsers and the Go, C and C++ grammars to the engine.

findings.title: The release-form Linux build still fails to link
findings.what: package.yml's command (napi build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --use-napi-cross --strip, glibc 2.17) at f06640857 fails at the link of the rerail-engine program after 995 s cold with 4 jobs: undefined gettid (5 references), sized operator delete (8), std::__cxx11::basic_string::_M_create (2) and fcntl64 (1), the same symbols as at aad1dd6ef. None of the causes changed between the heads, and the pull request's checks still build with the host's toolchain only.
findings.severity: high: the first release after the merge would fail on Linux
